name: coding
description: Programming tasks: writing, explaining and fixing code.

dev.prompt: Write a Python function that merges overlapping intervals in a list of (start, end) tuples. Include a short docstring and two test cases.

Explain what this C code does and point out the bug:

int sum(int *a, int n) { int s; for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) s += a[i]; return s; }
Implement an LRU cache class in JavaScript with get and put in O(1). Explain the data structures you use.

eval.prompt: Write a Rust function that returns the k most frequent words in a string, ignoring case and punctuation.
Explain the difference between a process and a thread, then show a minimal Python example that uses a thread pool to download three URLs.
Here is a SQL query that is slow on a large table: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE YEAR(created_at) = 2024. Explain why and rewrite it so an index can be used.
